create_Type_forward: create a Type autograd function forward pass to cast a tensor to a destination dtype
create_Type_backward: create a Type autograd function backward pass to cast gradient back to original input type
create_Resize_forward: create a Resize autograd function forward pass to reshape a tensor while preserving element count
create_Resize_backward: create a Resize autograd function backward pass to reshape gradient back to original tensor sizes
test_Type_Resize: test the Type and Resize autograd functions for tensor type casting and shape resizing
